Whole-lake N and P budget from the GLM-AED mass balance

Source: R/glm_mass_balance.R
glm_nutrient_balance.Rd

Closes the nitrogen and phosphorus budget of a GLM-AED run from its mass_balance.csv, in kg, and summarises it by year, month or the whole run. The components of total N (TN) and total P (TP) are summed as in calc_aed_totals_balance() (so they follow the AED configuration, including the phytoplankton internal nutrient quotas) and the budget is closed as in diag_glm_mass_balance():

Usage

glm_nutrient_balance(
  aeme,
  path = NULL,
  element = c("N", "P"),
  period = c("year", "month", "all"),
  include_spin_up = TRUE
)

Arguments

aeme

Aeme object that has been run with glm_aed.

path

character; root directory used with aeme.

element

character; "N", "P" or both.

period

character; summary resolution, "year" (default), "month" or "all" (the whole run).

include_spin_up

logical; keep the spin-up period? If FALSE, rows before the start of the simulation are dropped.

Value

a list with daily (the per-row budget from diag_glm_mass_balance() in kg, with an element column) and summary (per element and period: inflow, outflow, retained = inflow - outflow, d_storage, internal, all in kg, and retention_pct = 100 * retained / inflow). The first row has no previous storage and is excluded from the summary.

Details

internal = d(storage) - (inflow - outflow)

Reactions between pools cancel in the totals, so internal is the net amount gained (sediment release, atmospheric deposition, N fixation) or lost (burial, denitrification, settling to the sediment, seepage) across the lake boundary that the inflow and outflow terms do not see. A persistently large internal points to a missing source or sink. Inf and Out are totals over the save interval, so the sums are valid whatever nsave is.

See also

set_glm_balance_groups() to choose which variables GLM writes to the mass balance.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
nb <- glm_nutrient_balance(aeme, element = "N", period = "year")
nb$summary
} # }
